Gideon Sato, here's a draft for Mateo's procurement team, built from the #inc-vtg-hartford room (times are Pemberline company time, UTC-5, all on Aug 3, 2026):

*Hartford gate check-in incident: summary*
• *First report:* 10:42 AM. Both inbound lanes at the Hartford plant gate kiosks were showing a white screen after badge scan, and the guard fell back to logging trailers by hand.
• *Kiosk 1 back:* 11:03 AM. Mateo confirmed the guard checked in trailer 8836 and dispatch could see it.
• *Both lanes confirmed working:* 11:07 AM (posted at 11:08 AM). We're keeping the incident open for one more arrival cycle.
• *Still open:* Mateo's access to the status page. That's a separate issue and is tracked under INC-4821.

One note: the room doesn't say when kiosk 2 came back. The 11:07 time is the only confirmation for both lanes. I haven't sent this to anyone. It would be going to a Vantorre address, and mail outside pemberline.com needs Ruth Calloway's approval first.
